Name: SILVACO CVA6 AI-Assisted Power and Performance Design Space Explorer (PPM-DSE)
Description: ML-assisted framework for CVA6 power/performance modelling and automated design-space exploration. It generates or ingests assertion-filtered processor configurations and simulation datasets, trains surrogate models to predict cycle count, DMIPS/MHz and power, and supports sensitivity analysis, GP-PSO Bayesian optimization and multi-objective evolutionary search. Selected configurations are validated through Verilator performance simulation and, where available, gate-level power analysis. Outputs include CSV datasets, trained models and ranked CVA6 configurations.
